# Corelabs.blog

> > A technical knowledge hub covering non-destructive testing, safety compliance, scientific analysis, and interdisciplinary educational guides.

Corelabs.blog provides expert-level technical guides spanning materials testing (Ultrasonic Testing, Thermography, Shearography), regulatory compliance (NEC, OSHA, FDA REMS), scientific fundamentals (biochemistry, physics, spectroscopy), and humanities topics (literature analysis, music theory). The site serves professionals and students seeking practical, standards-based knowledge across engineering, healthcare, and academic disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)
- Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
- Thermography
- Shearography
- Delamination Detection
- NEC Compliance
- OSHA Standards
- Job Hazard Analysis (JHA)
- IR Spectroscopy
- Clinical Reasoning
- FDA REMS Programs
- Material Inspection
- Structural Integrity
- Aerospace Components
- Regulatory Compliance

## Non-Destructive Testing & Materials Inspection

- [Detect Delamination: Top Tools for Non-Destructive Inspection](https://corelabs.blog/detect-delamination-tools-inspection): NDT methods guide: Ultrasonic Testing, Thermography, Shearography for composites
- [Functional Group IR Table: Demystify Spectra (Practical Guide)](https://corelabs.blog/functional-group-ir-table-guide): IR spectroscopy guide for identifying functional groups and interpreting spectra
- [Limitations of Dichotomous Keys: Why They Fall Short [Analysis]](https://corelabs.blog/limitations-dichotomous-keys): Biological classification analysis: dichotomous keys vs DNA barcoding methods

## Safety & Regulatory Compliance

- [Sources of Help in Developing JHAs [Expert Guide]](https://corelabs.blog/sources-help-developing-jhas-expert-guide): Job Hazard Analysis development guide with OSHA/NIOSH resources and expertise
- [Which Form Maintains Signature Accountability [Digital Tools]](https://corelabs.blog/signature-accountability-field-digital-forms): E-signatures and mobile forms for field operations signature accountability
